parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 2A (CHEMBL224) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL224 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Sort by molecule ChEMBL identifier.
